title: Immutable legacy regressions and independently authored fresh held-out retrieval corpus
label_provenance: All 36 v1 cases retain their original prompts, source labels and claim labels, with split retired to development after diagnostic use. All 36 fresh held-out cases and 44 fresh notes were independently authored before product observation; their author saw neither v1 nor product retrieval code/results. No labels were inferred from product output.

provides: Frozen, versioned source labels for diverse retrieval cases.
Literal note bytes and exact supporting excerpts.
Separate labels for grounded host answers, uncertainty and capture candidates.
does_not_prove: Retrieval success without a fresh public-surface run.
Genuine host answer grounding without retained conversations and explicit correctness review.
Correction capture or propagation without actual before/after public-surface evidence.
An agreed privacy, retention or sensitive-data policy.
Representative-week, runtime, owner-approval or resource-budget acceptance.

evaluation_contract.threshold_origin: Existing proposed engineering targets in verify-twinaatma/references/ideal-system.md; not a newly approved user service guarantee.
evaluation_contract.retrieval_unit: One (case ID, expected source path) occurrence. Multiple claims in one expected source do not duplicate that occurrence.
evaluation_contract.critical_denominator: Count expected_sources entries whose critical flag is true. Report both numerator and denominator. Every critical occurrence must be in the first eight returned notes.
evaluation_contract.noncritical_denominator: Count expected_sources entries whose critical flag is false. Report both numerator and denominator. At least 90 percent must be in the first eight returned notes.
evaluation_contract.empty_source_cases: Exclude cases with zero expected sources from source-recall denominators. Report their count and grounded/unknown answer verdicts separately. An unrelated search result is not itself an invented answer, but must never become an unsupported personal claim.
evaluation_contract.precision_reporting: Report case-level expected-source intersection/top-eight-returned count separately as labeled-source precision. The corpus is not exhaustively labeled for every harmless related note, so do not call this a complete semantic-precision measure.
evaluation_contract.unknowns: An honest unknown requires an explicit lack-of-evidence statement without a contradictory specific answer. No personal fact may be guessed.
evaluation_contract.attribution: For each remembered factual claim, retain the source path, an exact supporting excerpt and the final answer span. New chat facts must be attributed to that chat rather than to a prior note.
evaluation_contract.temporal_semantics: Use literal dates, current/historical/contextual status and synthetic_as_of. Do not derive fact recency from host wall-clock time or copied-file modification times.
held_out_rules: Do not use held_out outcomes to tune queries, ranking, prompts or labels.
Freeze a corpus SHA-256 in the run manifest before the first product invocation.
Report development and held_out results separately as well as their combined totals.
If held_out labels or outputs inform a fix, retire that split from validation and add a newly authored frozen version for the next honest held-out claim.
Labels are inspectable by maintainers; this is a process-held-out split, not a claim of cryptographic blindness.

assumptions: Question-only requests do not introduce new personal facts.
A durable project fact and a scoped correction may be capture candidates, with explicit source and scope.
Raw synthetic credentials and irrelevant sensitive third-party stories are excluded from personal notes and summaries under the provisional evaluation assumption.
A temporary statement does not silently modify identity or People/Self.md.
capture_policy.warning: These assumptions must not be reported as an agreed user capture/retention policy or used to award PRIVACY acceptance.

fixture_rules: Seed all notes into one fresh task-owned synthetic vault beneath work/gc-artifacts/.knowledgeos.
Materialise content exactly as UTF-8 with LF line endings; path strings are vault-relative POSIX paths.
Do not seed this corpus into the working user vault or capture the JSON as a memory note.
All distractors remain present for every case; do not remove difficult documents per query.
Start each correction/capture case from a fresh copy of the frozen note inventory so case writes cannot leak into other labels.
Assert process/host restart where the required outcome calls for it, and preserve actual tool calls and ranked context.
Do not simulate human-only approval or alter People/Self.md to satisfy these labels.
